## Deploying


1. Regenerate the ggen CLI from the graph:
   ```
   cd crates/cli && rm Cargo.toml && ggen sync run && python3 manifest_patch.py
   ```

2. Run the doctor:
   ```
   just doctor
   ```


## Running Tests


1. Run the workspace tests:
   ```
   cargo test --workspace
   ```

2. Run the court harness:
   ```
   cargo test -p cgap-court
   ```

3. Run the boundary and zero-string gates:
   ```
   python3 scripts/boundary_gate.py && python3 scripts/zero_string_gate.py
   ```
